project: Double Dribble Rev 1 native C port
objective: Translate and verify 100% of reachable non-NES gameplay behavior into native C, with no runtime emulation or ROM dependency.

baseline.note: The existing percentage measures the old component catalog. The comprehensive routine score starts conservatively with all 216 portable nodes Partial until per-routine symbols, evidence, and regressions justify promotion.

included: CPU offense, defense, inbound, pass, shot, dunk, rebound, and loose-ball decisions
user control, switching, shooting, dunking, stealing, jumping, and blocking
team selection, team palettes, possession, score, clock, periods, fouls, violations, free throws, and match completion
portable animation selection, native rendering completeness, and asset-pack audio event playback
excluded: UxROM mapper and bank-switch implementation in the runtime
PPU register timing, VRAM command buffering, sprite-per-scanline limits, and OAM DMA
APU register emulation and NES nonlinear mixer implementation
hardware interrupt timing whose only effect is NES presentation
scope.boundary_rule: If a hardware-facing routine computes gameplay-visible state, timing, selection, collision, ownership, score, rule, animation, or audio-event behavior, that portable effect remains in scope even when its NES I/O mechanism is excluded.

required_for_each_routine_or_capability: active PRG bank, CPU address, ROM file offset, callers, callees, inputs, outputs, and confidence recorded
Ghidra disassembly or decompiler evidence generated by a checked-in headless script
FCEUX execution or controlled memory trace for every dynamically reachable branch; static proof is allowed only for unreachable or data-only branches and must be labeled
named native C state machine, helper, table, or asset-pack entry with no instruction interpreter or recorded-state playback
deterministic regression test covering normal and exceptional exits
original and native screenshot, audio, or state-trace checkpoint where behavior is observable
coverage ledger entry marked Verified only after all applicable evidence gates pass
project_exit_gate: all reachable portable routines are present in the exhaustive manifest
no portable routine or branch is Missing or Partial
all regression, build, asset-pack validation, Ghidra export, and capture commands pass
a complete match can progress through tip-off, live play, fouls, free throws, periods, and GAME SET without a stuck state
main is clean, rebuilt from the approved ROM into an ignored asset pack, committed, and pushed

commit_when: a coverage component gains at least two percentage points
a coherent recovered routine family becomes Verified
a high-impact regression is fixed and protected by tests
